jobs.title: Senior Clinical Pharmacologist
jobs.description:
The purpose of Idorsia is to challenge accepted medical paradigms, answering the questions that matter most. To achieve this, we will discover, develop, and commercialize transformative medicines – either with in-house capabilities or together with partners – and evolve Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial  Senior Clinical Pharmacologist to join our organization. In this role, you will operate in a lean, fast-paced environment with established core processes and systems, influencing the clinical pharmacology strategy across a high volume of First-in-Human (FIH) and early clinical programs , as well as ongoing studies.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role within Global Clinical Development, offering significant visibility and growth potential in the organization, and requiring close collaboration with Translational Research.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and execution of clinical pharmacology strategies and corresponding studies across multiple programs,

• Develop innovative and meaningful clinical pharmacology approaches that accelerate and de-risk drug development

• Define dose selection, escalation strategies, and characterize exposure-response relationships

• Ensure integration of nonclinical, translational, biomarker and clinical data to inform development decisions

• Design clinical studies with appropriate pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) endpoints

• Apply biomarkers and model-informed drug development (MIDD) approaches to enhance study design and decision-making

• Author and contribute to protocol development, including statistical and modeling/simulation considerations

• Serve as the primary clinical pharmacology interface with: Research, Translational Sciences, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs

• Represent clinical pharmacology at life cycle meetings

• Lead scientific discussions and provide strategic input in program governance meetings and decision-making forums

• Manage a large inflow of new clinical candidates alongside ongoing studies

• Author and contribute to regulatory documentation (IND/CTA, briefing documents, health authority responses)

• Represent clinical pharmacology in agency interactions as a subject matter expert

• Manage and oversee external partners (CROs, modeling vendors)

Qualifications & Experience

• PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent in Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacokinetics, or related field

• 10+ years of job relevant industry experience in biotech/pharma

• Proven track record in:

• Early clinical development (FIH through proof-of-concept)

• Study design and dose justification

• PK/PD modeling and interpretation

• Experience managing multiple concurrent programs in a dynamic environment

• Entrepreneurial mindset and intellectual curiosity with ability to thrive in ambiguity and rapid change

• Strong scientific leadership with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach

• Demonstrated ability to translate clinical pharmacology data into high-quality manuscripts, abstracts, and conference presentations

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery

Why Join Us?

• Join a science-led organization with a proven track record of innovative medicines from discovery to launch

• Opportunity to work on multiple innovative early-stage programs with a high level of ownership and visibility across the organization

• Thrive in an agile and entrepreneurial culture that champions innovative development over bureaucracy

Work  Location: Allschwil, Switzerland (primarily on-site)

Business Area: Global Clinical Development

Job Type: Permanent, full time

Job ID : 4767

At Idorsia, we harness the power of difference, authenticity, and inclusion to achieve business success.

We encourage all potential candidates with diverse backgrounds of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, and disability to submit their job applications. All applicants will receive consideration.

We are committed to fostering respect, fairness, and equal opportunities for all job applicants and our employees.

Please be informed that if you are selected for this position, your employment will be subject to a pre-employment background screening process, of which you would be informed in greater detail in due course.

Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd ("Idorsia") is committed to a fair and transparent application process. In order to avoid any conflict of interest in line with Idorsia Code of Business Conduct, which would undermine such a commitment, the applicants  must disclose any personal, financial, or other outside interests interfering with the interests of Idorsia. Further, the applicant is obliged to disclose any and all relationships with close or affiliated persons, who are employees of Idorsia or are collaborating with Idorsia in any other contractual relationship.

Please note Idorsia operates a strictly controlled list of preferred recruitment partners. For those partners who have no valid, signed Master Service Agreement in place with Idorsia, all unsolicited resumes, CVs, anonymous profiles, or any other candidate details submitted through our website or to personal e-mail accounts of employees of Idorsia Pharmaceuticals (including any of its subsidiaries, affiliates, or related companies) are considered the property of Idorsia Pharmaceuticals and are not subject to payment of any form of introduction, placement or referral fees.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lo scopo di Idorsia è di sfidare i paradigmi medici accettati, rispondendo alle domande più importanti. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, scopriremo, svilupperemo e commercializzeremo i farmaci trasformativi – sia con capacità interne che con partner – ed evolviamo l'Idorsia in un'azienda biofarmaceutica leader, con un forte nucleo scientifico. Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto e imprenditoriale Senior Clinical Pharmacologist per unirsi alla nostra organizzazione. In questo ruolo, si opera in un ambiente magra e veloce con processi e sistemi di base consolidati, influenzando la strategia di farmacologia clinica attraverso un alto volume di First-in-Human (FIH) e programmi clinici precoce, così come studi in corso. Si tratta di un ruolo pratico e ad alto impatto all'interno dello Sviluppo Clinico Globale, offrendo una visibilità significativa e un potenziale di crescita nell'organizzazione, e richiedendo una stretta collaborazione con la Ricerca Traduttiva. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione delle strategie di farmacologia clinica e gli studi corrispondenti su più programmi,
• Sviluppare approcci di farmacologia clinica innovativi e significativi che accelerano e de-rischiano lo sviluppo della droga
• Definire la selezione della dose, le strategie di escalation e caratterizzare le relazioni di esposizione-risposta
• Assicurare l'integrazione di dati non clinici, traduttivi, biomarcatori e clinici per informare le decisioni di sviluppo
• Studi clinici di progettazione con opportuni endpoint farmacocinetici (PK) e farmacodinamici (PD)
• Applicare biomarcatori e modelli di sviluppo della droga (MIDD) approcci per migliorare la progettazione e il processo decisionale dello studio
• Autore e contribuire allo sviluppo del protocollo, comprese le considerazioni statistiche e di modellazione/simulazione
• Servire come interfaccia clinica primaria di farmacologia con: Ricerca, Scienze Traduzionali, Biostatistica, Affari Regolatori
• Rappresentare la farmacologia clinica nelle riunioni del ciclo di vita
• Condurre discussioni scientifiche e fornire input strategici nelle riunioni di governance del programma e forum decisionali
• Gestire un grande flusso di nuovi candidati clinici insieme a studi in corso
• Autore e contribuire alla documentazione normativa (IND/CTA, documenti di briefing, risposte dell'autorità sanitaria)
• Rappresentare la farmacologia clinica nelle interazioni dell'agenzia come esperto di materia
• Gestione e supervisione di partner esterni (CRO, fornitori di modelli) Qualifiche e esperienza
• PhD, PharmD, MD, o equivalente in Farmacologia Clinica, Farmacocinetica, o campo relativo
• 10+ anni di esperienza nel settore del biotecnologia/farmaco
• Provato record in:
• Sviluppo clinico precoce (FIH attraverso la prova del concetto)
• Progettazione dello studio e giustificazione della dose
• Modellazione e interpretazione PK/PD
• Esperienza di gestione di più programmi concurrent in un ambiente dinamico
• Mindset imprenditoriale e curiosità intellettuale con capacità di prosperare in ambiguità e rapido cambiamento
• Forte leadership scientifica con un approccio pratico e orientato all'esecuzione
• Capacità dimostrata di tradurre i dati di farmacologia clinica in manoscritti di alta qualità, astratti e presentazioni di conferenze
• Eccellente collaborazione interfunzionale e competenze di influsso
• Capacità di bilanciare il pensiero strategico con la consegna operativa Perché unirsi a noi?
• Unisciti a un'organizzazione guidata dalla scienza con un comprovato record di farmaci innovativi dalla scoperta al lancio
• Opportunità di lavorare su più innovativi programmi di primo stadio con un alto livello di proprietà e visibilità in tutta l'organizzazione
• Thrive in una cultura agile e imprenditoriale che sostiene lo sviluppo innovativo sulla burocrazia Luogo di lavoro: Allschwil, Svizzera (principalmente in loco) Business Area: Sviluppo Clinico Globale Tipo di lavoro: Permanente, tempo pieno ID lavoro: 4767 A Idorsia, ci avvaliamo del potere della differenza, dell'autenticità e dell'inclusione per raggiungere il successo aziendale. Incoraggiamo tutti i potenziali candidati con diversi background di razza, colore, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, origine nazionale e disabilità per presentare le loro domande di lavoro. Tutti i candidati riceveranno considerazione. Ci impegniamo a promuovere il rispetto, la correttezza e le pari opportunità per tutti i candidati al lavoro e i nostri dipendenti. Si prega di essere informati che se siete selezionati per questa posizione, il vostro lavoro sarà soggetto a un processo di screening pre-occupazione di sfondo, di cui sarete informati in modo più dettagliato nel corso del tempo. Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd ("Idorsia") si impegna a un processo di applicazione equo e trasparente. Al fine di evitare qualsiasi conflitto di interesse in linea con il Codice di condotta aziendale Idorsia, che minerebbe tale impegno, i richiedenti devono rivelare qualsiasi personale, finanziario, o altri interessi esterni che interferiscono con gli interessi di Idorsia. Inoltre, il richiedente è tenuto a comunicare qualsiasi e tutti i rapporti con persone vicine o affiliate, che sono dipendenti di Idorsia o stanno collaborando con Idorsia in qualsiasi altro rapporto contrattuale. Idorsia gestisce un elenco rigorosamente controllato dei partner di reclutamento preferiti. Per i partner che non hanno un contratto di Master Service valido e firmato con Idorsia, tutti i curriculum non richiesti, i CV, i profili anonimi o qualsiasi altro dettaglio candidato presentato attraverso il nostro sito web o ai conti di posta elettronica personali dei dipendenti di Idorsia Pharmaceuticals (comprese le sue controllate, affiliate o società correlate) sono considerati di proprietà di Idorsia Pharmaceuticals e non sono soggetti a pagamento di qualsiasi forma di introduzione. The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients. To achieve this, we will develop Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

Join our Global Information Systems (GIS) team and help shape the digital future of Idorsia's global Supply Chain.

As our SAP Supply Chain Business Systems Analyst, you will partner with business stakeholders to optimize and enhance SAP S/4HANA solutions across Sourcing, Contract Manufacturing, Warehousing, Inventory Management, and Logistics. Acting as the link between business and IT, you will translate business needs into innovative, compliant, and efficient system solutions that support our global operations.

In this role, you will play a key part in driving process improvements, implementing new capabilities, and ensuring our Supply Chain systems continue to support the successful delivery of medicines to patients worldwide.

Your responsibilities

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective SAP S/4HANA solutions.

• Configure, implement, test, and continuously improve Supply Chain business processes and system functionality.

• Manage system releases, upgrades, vendor coordination, validation activities, and user acceptance testing.

• Provide system support, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolutions with IT teams and software vendors.

• Ensure compliance with CSV requirements, IT standards, and Quality System documentation.

• Develop training materials, deliver end-user training, and promote user adoption.

• Contribute to system strategy, digitalization initiatives, and continuous process improvements.

• Lead or support small business and system implementation projects.

What you'll bring

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• 5+ years of professional experience, ideally within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience supporting Supply Chain business processes and SAP S/4HANA, particularly MM, IM and LE (QM and SD are an advantage).

• Understanding global trade compliance and Supply Chain master data.

• Experience managing SaaS applications, system releases, testing, and user training.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to bridge business and technology.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Self-driven, collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment.

• Fluent English: German and/or French are an advantage.

Why join us?

• Shape the digital transformation of a global biopharmaceutical company.

• Work on business-critical SAP S/4HANA solutions with real business impact.

• Collaborate with international, cross-functional teams.

• Take ownership, drive improvements, and continuously develop your expertise.

Work  Location: Allschwil, Switzerland

Business Area: Global Information Sevices

Schedule: Fulltime (office presence 2-3 days/week)

Job Type: Permanent

Job ID : 4794

• Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per comprendere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni SAP S/4HANA efficaci.

• Gestisci release di sistema, aggiornamenti, coordinamento del fornitore, attività di validazione e test di accettazione dell'utente.

• Fornire supporto di sistema, problemi di risoluzione dei problemi e le risoluzioni di coordinate con team IT e fornitori di software.

• Assicurare la conformità ai requisiti CSV, agli standard IT e alla documentazione del sistema di qualità.

• Sviluppare materiali di formazione, fornire formazione degli utenti finali e promuovere l'adozione degli utenti.

• Contribuire alla strategia di sistema, alle iniziative di digitalizzazione e ai continui miglioramenti dei processi.

• Guidare o sostenere piccoli progetti di implementazione di business e di sistema.

Cosa porterai

• Laurea in Informatica, Sistemi Informativi, o una disciplina correlata.

• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente nell'industria farmaceutica.

• Esperienza che supporta i processi aziendali di Supply Chain e SAP S/4HANA, in particolare MM, IM e LE (QM e SD sono un vantaggio).

• Comprendere la conformità commerciale globale e i dati master Supply Chain.

• Gestione delle applicazioni SaaS, release di sistema, test e formazione degli utenti.

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di bridge business e tecnologia.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

• Lavoro autonomo, collaborativo, proattivo e confortevole in un ambiente dinamico internazionale.

• Inglese fluente: tedesco e/o francese sono un vantaggio.

Perché unirsi a noi?

• Formare la trasformazione digitale di una società biofarmaceutica globale.

• Lavorare sulle soluzioni SAP S/4HANA business-critical con un impatto reale sul business.

• Collabora con team internazionali e interfunzionali.

• Prendere la proprietà, migliorare l'unità e sviluppare continuamente la vostra esperienza.

jobs.title: Clinical Development Lead
jobs.description:
The purpose of Idorsia is to challenge accepted medical paradigms, answering the questions that matter most. To achieve this, we will discover, develop, and commercialize transformative medicines – either with in-house capabilities or together with partners – and evolve Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

Are you an experienced clinical development professional eager to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated therapy?

We are seeking a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on  Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central role in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

This role offers the opportunity to shape lifecycle evidence generation and unlock the full potential of differentiated medicines through clinically meaningful, scientifically robust and strategically aligned development activities.

Working closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs and Commercial colleagues, you will ensure development plans are scientifically robust, operationally feasible and strategically aligned. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Clinical Development Lead is the clinical and scientific expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:

• Lead the multidisciplinary Clinical Team at development-program level, providing scientific direction, strategic alignment and accountability across the program.

• Shape innovative clinical development strategies that maximize the compound's value throughout its lifecycle, integrating emerging scientific evidence and evolving standard of care into development plans.

• Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.

• Provide thought leadership in clinical trial design and execution in close partnership with key functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear prioritisation and timely delivery.

• Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.

• Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.

• Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.

• Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.

• Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.

• Represent the Company as a credible scientific leader externally with investigators, scientific experts, advisory boards and Health Authorities.

• Champion the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and support the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements

• Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc or equivalent.

About the Company

The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop, and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients.

Headquartered in Switzerland – a biotech-hub of Europe – Idorsia is a high-potential biopharmaceutical company, specialized in the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative small molecules, with the aim of transforming the horizon of therapeutic options.

We are now looking for a highly motivated  Postdoctoral Researcher in the Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) section of our Nonclinical Development department (2 years).

Job Responsibilities

• Establish and evaluate New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) such as advanced in vitro hepatic systems to improve the prediction of human clearance, with a particular focus on low-turnover compounds.

• Compare intrinsic clearance data generated in conventional systems, such as human liver microsomes and cryopreserved hepatocytes, with data from more complex liver-cell models such as HepaRG, HepatoPac, TruVivo or related systems.

• Develop and apply robust LC-MS/MS bioanalytical methods to quantify parent compound depletion and, where appropriate, metabolite formation in those assays.

• Investigate the impact of nonspecific binding, compound stability, incubation recovery and free concentration on the interpretation of clearance data and support in vitro–in vivo extrapolation in collaboration with DMPK modelers.

• Assess the suitability of advanced hepatic systems for drug-metabolizing enzyme phenotyping in comparison with human liver microsomes, integrating metabolite identification where appropriate.

• Document, analyze and present experimental results in multidisciplinary project teams, and contribute to scientific reports, internal presentations, conference communications and peer-reviewed publications.

Candidate’s Requirements

• PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, biology, pharmacology or a related discipline, with solid scientific training and a strong interest in applying experimental and analytical skills to DMPK questions.

• Hands-on experience with cell culture and LC-MS/MS bioanalysis is required; experience with high-resolution MS and/or metabolite identification is an advantage.

• Experience with in vitro ADME/DMPK assays, such as microsomal or hepatocyte stability, protein binding, drug-metabolizing enzyme phenotyping, is desirable.

• Good understanding of drug metabolism, hepatic clearance mechanisms, enzyme phenotyping and in vitro–in vivo extrapolation, or strong motivation to develop expertise in these areas.

• Proactive, collaborative and reliable personality with strong analytical thinking, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.

• Excellent knowledge of English.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
jobs.description:
About the Company

The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop, and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients.

Headquartered in Switzerland – a biotech-hub of Europe – Idorsia is a high-potential biopharmaceutical company, specialized in the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative small molecules, with the aim of transforming the horizon of therapeutic options.

We are now looking for a highly motivated  Postdoctoral Researcher in CNS Biology/Pharmacology to join our Biological Sciences Group

Job Responsibilities

To strengthen our mode-of-action and disease biology characterization efforts in CNS biology/pharmacology, we are offering a Postdoc position for a highly motivated neurobiologist. The successful candidate will have solid experience with hiPSC-derived neuronal cocultures, as well as basic knowledge of neuronal circuit modeling and analysis. In this role you will investigate the effect of innovative therapeutic agents in neuronal co-culture models of disease using a broad array of readouts. L'objectif d'Idorsia est de découvrir, développer et commercialiser des médicaments innovants pour aider davantage de patients. Basée en Suisse – un hub-biotech d'Europe – Idorsia est une entreprise biopharmaceutique à fort potentiel, spécialisée dans la découverte, le développement et la commercialisation de petites molécules innovantes, dans le but de transformer l'horizon des options thérapeutiques. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de projet technique – Substance médicamenteuse pour rejoindre notre équipe de la Stratégie sur les substances médicamenteuses et l'approvisionnement en eau afin de diriger le développement de nouvelles entités chimiques axées sur les substances médicamenteuses. Idorsia exécute actuellement des programmes de développement pour de nombreux produits à toutes les phases cliniques (I, II et III) et gère des actifs commerciaux. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Le responsable du projet technique, Substance médicamenteuse, dirigera le développement technique de plusieurs substances médicamenteuses, de la phase initiale à la phase tardive jusqu'à l'arrêt du commerce ou du produit. Les principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :
• Diriger et gérer le développement, l'analyse et la production de substances médicamenteuses pour les projets assignés à des fins d'approvisionnement clinique et/ou commercial.
• Activités de fabrication de plomb et d'expansion vers l'API, y compris l'approvisionnement en blocs de construction, en matériaux de départ réglementaires ou en produits intermédiaires BPF
• Transfert technique de plomb pour les procédés de substances médicamenteuses et définition des RPC et des RMR pour les substances médicamenteuses
• Diriger les activités techniques de mise au point de substances médicamenteuses (internes ou externes) : planifier, organiser et administrer les différents aspects des activités techniques nécessaires à la mise au point, à l'échelle, à la validation et à la fabrication d'un médicament, de la mise au point à la fourniture commerciale
